description: Preview item that orchestrates Fabric deployments by defining item ordering and pre/post deployment actions.

definition_parts.description: Required deployment plan definition using the DeploymentPlanV1 executable format.

flags.--file: Raw plan.yml or a complete definition envelope.
flags.--folder-id: Optional workspace folder for the item.
flags.--update-metadata: Update item metadata from the submitted definition.

notes: Deployment plan items and their integration with Git, bulk import, and deployment pipelines are Preview/Beta.
Git pull and bulk import reference deployment plans by logical ID; deployment-pipeline deploy references them by item ID.
Beta query activation is automatic when a deployment-plan reference flag is supplied.
